searchText: Anyone have Prysm up and running? My node seems to connect to geth and sync just fine, but I still get repeated `Unable to retreive genesis ETH1.0 chain header: not found`. Nishant said those errors were cosmetic and could be ignored, but then when running validators, I get contradicting messages as to whether or not ETH1 is connected. ``` 2021-12-23 02:10:31] INFO powchain: Connected to eth1 proof-of-work chain endpoint=http://192.168.0.2:8549 [2021-12-23 02:10:32] ERROR powchain: Unable to retrieve genesis ETH1.0 chain header: not found [2021-12-23 02:10:34] WARN rpc/validator: Not connected to ETH1. Cannot determine validator ETH1 deposit block number ``` Prysm not working for me. Followed these steps: https://hackmd.io/dFzKxB3ISWO8juUqPpJFfw using Docker containers for both EL and CL. On top updated the Prysm Kintsugi docker version (30ed0d->97027b) Seeing your error as well as getting weird sync behaviour and sync loops. Had to change the bootstrap node in order to get peers. Also: `ERROR powchain: Could not connect to powchain endpoint error=json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field SyncProgress.StartingBlock of type uint64` I'm using Nethermind as EL. Does it work when using Geth as EL? I will look into Nethermind now I also updated the instruction to correct bootstrap node and added `kintsugi-testnet` flag. Running beacon node becomes easier: `bazel run //beacon-chain -- --genesis-state $PWD/../genesis.ssz --datadir $PWD/../datadir-prysm --http-web3provider=http://localhost:8545 --kintsugi-testnet` The latest docker image is: `gcr.io/prysmaticlabs/prysm/beacon-chain:kintsugi-9475bc` Update on this: Once the validators became active, the WARN message went away, and attestations are submitted successfully, but the ERROR message remains. <@!363800010518822915> I created an issue for the sync loop issue and included the log. It happens with nethermind, but not geth. https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/issues/10037 That is probably a Nethermind issue. We have some known bugs during the sync. We're working on it. (cc: <@!474451342094499868> <@!363800010518822915> )

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
Does it work when using Geth as EL? I will look into Nethermind now

The latest docker image is: `gcr.io/prysmaticlabs/prysm/beacon-chain:kintsugi-9475bc`
